description: This file defines a jQuery plugin called 'radioswitch' that creates a switch widget using radio buttons, supporting accessibility and customizable options. It includes methods for initializing, switching states, enabling/disabling, and retrieving the current state of the widget.

methods.name: __init
methods.description: Initializes the radioswitch widget, creating DOM elements, setting initial state, and binding event handlers.

methods.name: __doSwitch
methods.description: Internal method to switch the widget to 'on' or 'off' state, updating DOM classes and ARIA attributes.

methods.name: option
methods.description: Placeholder for future options modification; currently does not allow changing options after initialization.

methods.name: doSwitch
methods.description: Public method to switch the widget state to 'on' or 'off', optionally triggering a change event.

methods.name: doEnable
methods.description: Enables or disables the entire widget, affecting user interaction.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the widget, including whether it is 'on' and enabled.
